title: GFS analysis at 0.25 degrees: the atmosphere at 13 pressure levels and near the surface, to start a forecast model
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction, through the NOMADS GRIB filter

cycle.description: the analysis time (UTC), moved down to a cycle (00, 06, 12 or 18 UTC); NOMADS keeps the last ten days, and a cycle appears about 4 hours after its time

format: GRIB2, 70 messages: geopotential height (gpm), specific humidity (kg kg-1), temperature (K), eastward and northward wind (m s-1) at 1000, 925, 850, 700, 600, 500, 400, 300, 250, 200, 150, 100 and 50 hPa; pressure at mean sea level (Pa); temperature and specific humidity at 2 m; wind at 10 m. Grid 0.25 degrees, 1440 x 721, latitude 90 to -90, longitude 0 to 359.75. Complex packing with spatial differencing; read with ecCodes.
licence: Public domain (US Government work); NOAA asks that NOMADS be used at no more than 120 requests a minute
citation: NOAA NCEP (2026), Global Forecast System, analysis, through NOMADS (https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/).
